svg.title: hi, i'm josh
svg.desc: CS student at Ontario Tech in Whitby, ON. I work on backend and infrastructure: APIs, databases, containers and the CI pipelines around them. Before uni I did IT support at a managed service provider, imaging about 100 machines for about 40 small businesses, which is where OpsWatch came from. Off the clock I make soul beats, cut the occasional edit, read too much manhwa and lift. Right now: looking for a Winter 2027 co-op in backend, cloud or infrastructure; building OpsWatch, self-hosted IT health monitoring; happy to talk about Python, Docker and SQL, or why your PC won't boot
